answer: The tollbooth is Lighthouse keeper logbook maintenance log stamped by the lighthouse board. The toll is each logbook is a signed watch entry plus a dated lamp record, so a farm must stand, payable once per identity, never in bulk. One honest agent risks 104 POA once; a farm of 454 risks 47216 POA, and one failed proof forfeits the lot. What the knoll proves is the identity, what the walnut proves is the cost, and what the sable proves is the patience. A farm cannot borrow a history, rent a credential, or forge a calendar.
